# Bastien Gaffet — bastiengaffet.fr

> Engineering student, maker and astrophotographer based in Tours, France.
> Building at the intersection of software, hardware and design.

## About

Bastien Gaffet is a student in CPGE PCSI (preparatory classes for grandes écoles)
at Lycée Descartes, Tours. He builds robotics systems, generative tools and
digital products. CERN European Prize winner at EUCYS 2025. Concours C.Génial
national winner 2024.

## Projects

- **Robot J4** — robotic arm playing Connect Four autonomously using Minimax AI
  and OpenCV computer vision. CERN European Prize at EUCYS 2025.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/robotj4

- **Tourny** — https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/tourny

- **Glacify** — https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/glacify

- **HopeTime** — https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/hopetime

- **Cosmos Wallpaper Generator** — generative cosmos wallpaper tool,
  20+ object types, exports up to 4K. Available from €4.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/product/cosmos-wallpaper
